unit.note: shared/tests is the one root this change touches; ADR-044 forbids composing roots in one pytest process.

integration.note: Covered inside shared/tests; no separate integration-tests root touched by this diff.

e2e.note: No web surface; F0.5 ran surface=cli.

surface_verification.note: Exercises main() end to end (argv parsing, manifest resolution, verdict, exit code) plus the resolver.

behaviors.behavior: The compared version dir is the one installed_plugins.json names, not the highest SemVer present
The change is load-bearing: the pre-change resolver returns the OPPOSITE verdict on the identical fixture
A manifest-named dir that does not exist is not_in_cache, never a silent fallback to another version
With no manifest the highest cached version is used and version_basis says so
A malformed manifest degrades to the fallback instead of crashing the session
A plugin absent from the manifest falls back
A manifest entry carrying no installPath falls back
Every plugin record carries version_basis, on every status
A plugin entry that is an object (entries[0] raises KeyError) falls back rather than crashing
A denied or unstatable candidate reads as unreadable, not absent
The absent/unreadable reason is probed on the CANDIDATE, not its parent
behaviors.evidence: test_plugin_cache_version_robustness::test_the_resolver_probes_the_candidate_and_not_its_parent PASSED; MUTATION-VERIFIED: call site changed to _probe_missing_dir(candidate.parent) is CAUGHT (missed by the direct-call test, which is why this one goes through resolve_version_dir)

behaviors.behavior: A denied stat does not escape check_sync's documented no-exception-leaks contract
behaviors.evidence: test_plugin_cache_version_robustness::test_a_denied_stat_does_not_escape_the_resolver PASSED; MUTATION-VERIFIED: reverting os.path.isdir -> Path.is_dir is CAUGHT

behaviors.behavior: An installPath outside the given cache root is named in the basis rather than measured silently
A guessed version dir is named on the DRIFT line
A guessed version dir is named on the GREEN line (the false-green half)
A real manifest lookup prints no note, so the signal is not on 100% of the time
The manifest applies by default only to the cache root it describes
An explicit --installed-plugins always wins
One verdict rests on ONE reading of the manifest (read once, not once per plugin)
Producer and checker read the same manifest path (derived from the Python side, not restated)
Producer and checker read the same keys and the same entry index
The lookup key is <plugin>@<marketplace> on both sides, separator and name
The sync's copy target IS the pinned _install_path output, not merely a function that still exists
The sync copies every plugin the check inspects (hardcoded array vs repo glob)
Both sides agree on the cache root, which is DERIVED from MARKETPLACE_NAME rather than restated
Existing check_sync callers that pass no manifest keep their prior behaviour (backward compatibility)
